analysis.title: SolarEdge Technologies Inc. (SEDG): Near-term recovery pushed out on US/Germany uncertainty; Nexis traction continues; Sell
key_insights: GS reiterates Sell on SEDG with the 12-month price target cut to $25 from $29, implying 24.0% downside from $32.88 (price as of 3 Nov 2026 close).
3Q26 results were largely in line. Revenue was $326mn vs GSe $322mn and FactSet consensus of ~$327mn. Adj. EPS was $0.29 vs GSe of ($0.00) and consensus of $0.04.

3Q26 profitability benefited from IEEPA tariff-related refunds. Non-GAAP gross margin was 34.7% vs GSe 27.8% and company guidance of 22%-26%. Excluding ~$36mn of IEEPA benefits, underlying gross margin was ~23.6%, near the guidance midpoint.

4Q26 revenue guidance of $245mn-$275mn is well below GSe/consensus of $317mn/$321mn, implying a ~20% qoq decline at the midpoint. Management is proactively reducing channel inventory amid FEOC uncertainty in the US and potential feed-in-tariff reductions in Germany.

Of the ~$50mn reduction at the midpoint vs the ~$310mn 4Q level outlined at Investor Day, ~$35mn is from more conservative channel inventory management in the US and Germany, ~$10mn from de-emphasizing less-profitable markets and ~$5mn from FX.

4Q26 non-GAAP gross margin is guided to 17%-21% vs GSe of 27.9%, reflecting fixed-cost underabsorption at lower volumes. Non-GAAP opex is guided to $87mn-$91mn vs GSe $91mn. The guide excludes ~$4mn of expected IEEPA refunds in 4Q.

Management expects 1Q27 revenue to decline 10% sequentially on winter seasonality and US/Germany uncertainty. It then expects regulatory uncertainty to ease, with roughly flat yoy revenue and adjusted EBITDA around breakeven for FY27.

Additional cost actions should save ~$5mn per quarter from 1Q27 (~$3mn COGS, ~$2mn opex). The company is de-emphasizing markets representing ~$40mn-$50mn of annual revenue. FY26 capex guidance was cut to ~$45mn-$55mn and positive FY26 FCF is still expected.

Nexis contributed >$100mn of revenue in 3Q26, up from >$60mn previously. Storage was the largest product category for the second straight quarter. Storage retrofit revenue in Germany and the Netherlands rose to >$30mn from >$20mn in 2Q26. Single-phase Nexis launches in Europe in 1Q27.
SST development is on track for a working system by YE26, customer pilots in 2027 and volume shipments in 2028.
GS cut 2026-2028 adj. EPS estimates to ($0.61)/($0.21)/$1.35 from ($0.41)/$0.64/$1.42. 2027 revenue was cut 12% to $1,234.8mn from $1,405.9mn, and 2028 revenue was cut 8% to $1,435.0mn.
The price target is based on 17x P/E (vs 20x prior) on Q5-Q8 EPS. The lower multiple reflects the delayed pace of recovery.

market_movers.rationale: Price target cut to $25 from $29 on a lower 17x P/E multiple (from 20x) as 4Q26 guidance and 1Q27 outlook delay the recovery. Implies 24.0% downside from $32.88.

sector_views.rationale: GS sees SEDG's recovery delayed by FEOC uncertainty in the US and potential feed-in-tariff cuts under proposed renewable policy reforms in Germany.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 reported 11/4 note: revenue $326.1mn vs GSe $322.4mn and FactSet consensus ~$327mn, down 6% qoq and 4% yoy.
3Q26 non-GAAP EPS $0.29 (reported) vs GSe ($0.00) and consensus $0.04. GAAP diluted EPS was ($0.14) vs GSe ($0.58).
3Q26 non-GAAP gross margin 34.7% reported vs GSe 27.8%. Excluding ~$36mn IEEPA tariff-related benefits, ~23.6%. Company guidance was 22%-26%.
3Q26 non-GAAP opex ~$89mn vs guide of $86mn-$91mn, giving non-GAAP operating income of ~$24mn. FCF was ~$8mn vs ~$3mn in 2Q26, the fifth consecutive positive quarter.
3Q26 shipments: ~86k inverters (up 38% qoq, down 7% yoy, implied ~$766/unit), ~2.4mn optimizers (down 5% qoq, down 20% yoy, ~$40/unit), 388 MWh batteries (down 9% qoq, up 69% yoy, $314/kWh).

4Q26 guidance (issued with the 3Q26 report): revenue $245mn-$275mn vs GS prior $317mn and Street $321mn. Non-GAAP gross margin 17%-21% vs GSe 27.9%. Non-GAAP opex $87mn-$91mn vs GSe $91mn. Prior GS 4Q26 EPS estimate was ($0.06) vs Street ($0.02).

GS estimates (not reported figures): FY26E revenue $1,242.7mn (prior $1,296.3mn), FY27E $1,234.8mn (prior $1,405.9mn), FY28E $1,435.0mn (prior $1,553.3mn). Adj. EPS FY26E ($0.61), FY27E ($0.21), FY28E $1.35.

trade_ideas.description: Sell rating on SEDG with a 12-month price target of $25.00 (24.0% downside from $32.88)
trade_ideas.rationale: Near-term recovery is pushed out by weak 4Q26 guidance, a further 10% sequential decline in 1Q27 and US/Germany policy uncertainty.
trade_ideas.risk: Increases in energy prices, interest rate decline, increase in inverter pricing, lower costs, and broad market acceptance of SSTs.

risk_factors: Key risks to the Sell view per GS: increases in energy prices, interest rate decline, increase in inverter pricing, lower costs, and broad market acceptance of SSTs.
US FEOC uncertainty and potential German feed-in-tariff reductions could prolong channel inventory destocking.
3Q26 gross margin was inflated by ~$36mn of IEEPA tariff-related refunds, so underlying profitability is weaker than the headline.
geopolitical: US FEOC (foreign entity of concern) uncertainty is leading management to cut channel inventory in the US.
Proposed renewable policy reforms in Germany include potential reductions in feed-in-tariff support, leading distributors to manage inventory cautiously.
IEEPA tariff-related refunds boosted SEDG's 3Q26 gross margin by ~$36mn, with ~$4mn still expected in 4Q.
